{{Top}}
{{Quote|Boy, it's lucky you had these compartments.''"<br />"''I use them for smuggling. I never thought I'd be smuggling myself in 'em.|[[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] and [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]]|<ref name="Episode 4">{{Film|IV}}</ref>}}
[[File:Smuggling_compartment-TCG_EoD.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Smuggling compartments]]
'''Smuggling compartments''' were hidden, hollow spaces in [[Starship/Legends|starships]] and other vehicles made to hide contraband from customs searches. The [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']] was modified with smuggling compartments. Han Solo, Chewbacca, Luke Skywalker, C-3PO, R2-D2, and Obi-Wan Kenobi [[Rescue of Princess Leia/Legends|once]] utilized these compartments to avoid the initial searches, although a scanner crew was later brought aboard.
